Nexus.TutorialTitle: Get your Nexus Mods API key
Nexus.TutorialSteps:
1. Open https://www.nexusmods.com/settings/api-keys
2. Scroll to the very bottom of the page
3. Find 'Personal API Key'
4. Generate / copy it
5. Paste it into the box above and click Save key.
Nexus.PageOpened: The page opened in your browser. Paste the key into the box above.
